hook: Blocking mitochondrial protein import makes melanoma cells easier for T cells to spot, in models.
summary: Depleting the import subunit TIMM50 lets mitochondrial DNA escape, which activates cGAS-STING, interferon-beta release and more MHC class I antigen display. This synergized with checkpoint blockade in melanoma models. The evidence is from cell and mouse models, and a safe way to inhibit import in patients is not shown.
title: Mitochondrial protein import defects enhance tumour immunogenicity.
